title: Can c62's fusing Flow-Lenia predators carry a heritable trait if traits pass through merges by sampling rather than averaging (Plantec et al. 2025)?
summary: Can c62's fusing Flow-Lenia predators carry a heritable trait if traits pass through merges by sampling rather than averaging (Plantec et al. 2025)? Proposed one-loop experiment below.
experiment: Give predator matter a trait field moved with it by reintegration tracking; where predator matter from different sources lands in one cell, keep the trait of the largest contribution (argmax) or sample by share; let the trait set the predator's kernel radius scale; mutate by beams. Run 160^2, t=6000, 2 seeds, against an identical-draw neutral twin (trait read by nothing). Report trait fidelity at persistent splits and at merges. Expect reviewers to ask whether a sampling rule is an imposed inheritance.
